programme.desc: Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
programme.desc: Live from London, we catch you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. Plus, we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The Opening Trade
programme.desc: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. We break down today's biggest stories and speak to guests with skin in the game.

programme.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programme.desc: Conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, finance and politics. We go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programme.title: Bloomberg Brief
programme.desc: Delivering the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. Hosted by Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern.

programme.title: Bloomberg Markets
programme.desc: Bloomberg Markets is focused on bringing you the most important global business and breaking markets news and information as it happens.

programme.title: Bloomberg ETF IQ: Special Edition
programme.desc: Bloomberg ETF IQ is live from the ETFs in Depth conference in New York City. Our hosts talk to leaders in the ETF market, providing critical intelligence to financial advisers and investors in ETFs.

programme.title: Businessweek Convenes: A Frank Conversation on AI & Hollywood
programme.desc: From Bloomberg Screentime, Hollywood leaders examine how AI is reshaping the business of entertainment, from creative work and jobs to economics and ownership.

programme.title: Bloomberg Tech: Decoding the Future
programme.desc: The content, capital and connectivity powering Tech's most groundbreaking ideas, from industrial robots and consumer electronics to the race to reach artificial general intelligence.

programme.title: How Larry Ellison Built His Empire
programme.desc: Expanding from database software into AI and media, Larry Ellison is placing his biggest bets yet. Bloomberg Originals explores what drives the 82-year-old tech billionaire.

programme.title: The Deal with Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programme.desc: Alex and Jason talk with WWE president Nick Khan at Bloomberg's Screentime conference about his deals with Netflix and ESPN.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Emily travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world.

programme.title: The Deal with Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programme.desc: Alex and Jason talk with entrepreneur and investor Alexis Ohanian at Bloomberg's Power Players conference about investing in women's sports.

programme.title: Bloomberg Wall Street Week
programme.desc: A weekly program telling the stories of capitalism from around the world, hosted by David Westin in New York.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: WARRIOR tells the moving and inspirational story of the Conlon family, Brendan (Joel Edgerton), Tommy (Tom Hardy) and Paddy (Nick Nolte), who find redemption in the ring as they fight to repair themselves and their family.

programme.title: My Super Ex-Girlfriend
programme.desc: When he breaks up with his girlfriend, he discovers his ex is actually the reluctant superhero, G Girl. A scorned woman, she unleashes her super powers to humiliate and torment him.

programme.title: Operation Valkyrie
programme.desc: High commanding officers conspire a plot to assassinate Adolf Hitler in July 1944. Based on a true story.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Mads Mikkelsen stars as a pilot whose plane has crashed in a remote corner of the Arctic. Stranded in the wilderness he uses his ingenuity to survive. But he is forced to make a perilous choice between the safety of his camp and a trek into the unknown.

programme.title: Curse of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Inspector Clouseau is missing and the Pink Panther (David Niven) is hot on his trail in this wildly funny laugh-fest that offers plenty of slapstick humor and a myriad of stars including Joanna Lumley, Herbert Lom and Robert Wagner.

programme.title: Of Mice and Men
programme.desc: John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Told against the sweeping panoramas of the Sahara desert, this epic features an exotic mix of action, suspense, and romance and delivers a caravan of excitement - with screen icons John Wayne and Sophia Loren fighting to survive an arduous journey!

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse
programme.desc: To further his research into alligator feeding patterns, Edgar decides to do some observing at the alligator habitat at the Megalopolis Zoo. During the observation, the usually docile alligators start to behave violently when they see Kane.

programme.title: Massive Monster Mayhem
programme.desc: Master Mayhem has created a new chart-topping pop trio: The Doo Doo Dooms! These three musical monsters will melt your heart, then melt your planet! Meanwhile Eye Eye Eye will do anything for some peace and quiet… like conquer Earth!

programme.title: Massive Monster Mayhem
programme.desc: Master Mayhem takes us behind the scenes to show how all that Mayhem gets made! But he accidentally reveals a bit too much, and once the galaxy has seen MM’s cute little “Dream Board” his only solution is to have RoBro destroy us all.

programme.title: Class of the Titans: Labour Day
programme.desc: Cronus sends Herry back in time to perform the Labours of Hercules. A lion, a hydra, a dragon; oh my! Jay and the others try to save Herry, but first they have to face the music of the seductive Sirens!

programme.title: Sabrina's Secret Life: Spell-Ing Bee
programme.desc: It’s Witch vs. Witch in the annual spell-a-thon, and Sabrina is determined she is going to cast the biggest and best spell of all.

programme.title: Sabrina's Secret Life: And Baby Makes 3
programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda are going to the Netherworld for some much needed Rest & Relaxation (it’s the witch equivalent of going to Las Vegas). Although Sabrina does everything her power to dissuade them, they insist on hiring a babysitter.

programme.title: Sabrina's Secret Life: Half There
programme.desc: Sabrina’s cauldron blows up and splatters Cassandra with purplescent slime.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada: Remorse
